description: This Java class 'RetrieveFeaturePropertiesStrategy' implements a strategy for handling 'RetrieveFeatureProperties' commands within a thing persistence context. It retrieves specific feature properties from a 'Thing' object based on provided command parameters, and generates appropriate result objects.

classes.name: RetrieveFeaturePropertiesStrategy
classes.description: An implementation of a command strategy that handles retrieval of feature properties for a specific 'Feature' within a 'Thing'. It processes the command, extracts the feature, retrieves properties, and constructs the appropriate result.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the main logic to handle the 'RetrieveFeatureProperties' command, returning a result containing the feature event.

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Extracts the specified feature from the 'Thing' object based on the command parameter.

methods.name: getFeatureProperties
methods.description: Retrieves feature properties, creates a JSON representation, and constructs the response.

methods.name: getFeaturePropertiesJson
methods.description: Converts feature properties into a JSON object considering selected fields and schema version.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Provides the previous entity tag for versioning or concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Calculates the next entity tag based on the current state of the feature's properties.
